jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Design
jobs.description:
About SaniSure

SaniSure is a high-growth multinational manufacturer of single-use products and systems used in the production of biological drugs, including cell therapies, gene therapies, and vaccines. With operations in the U.S. and Europe, we supply global pharmaceutical and biotech companies with the critical tools they need to develop and manufacture some of today's most innovative and life-changing medicines.

As we continue to expand our product offerings and global footprint, SaniSure offers an exciting opportunity to join a nimble, customer-focused company at the forefront of the biotech industry.

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering – Design is responsible for global product design at SaniSure. Scope includes assuring velocity and efficiency of drawing and Bill of Material throughput while maintaining accuracy and quality, tracking and managing associated key performance indicators (KPIs), selecting and deploying software, training, design tools, and design libraries, authoring and updating design SOPs and Work Instructions, engineering data integrity and data services, and the Engineering portions of product change control and change management, and urgently resolving design-related issues that impact production and end-customers.

Essential Functions

Manage the global team responsible for computer-aided design (CAD) at SaniSure. Set and continuously improve global CAD standards, templates, design libraries, and assure deployment and training.
Provide global leadership for deployment of 3D CAD and PDM. Work cross-functionally to build out the global data systems framework.
Develop deep product knowledge to provide technical design expertise to Sales, Customers, and other functional areas. Consult with other subject matter experts as required.
Review design requirements inputs from Customers, Sales, and Product Line Managers. Assure requirements are clearly translated into design features. Push for clarity and for closure of gaps in information.
Serve as the main point of Design contact for major customer Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
Analyze mechanical designs, including sketches, technical drawings, schematics, specifications and associated product measurements. Conduct risk assessments using FMEA framework, and drive risk mitigations as required. Lead design and drawing reviews as needed.
Promote the options for presenting alternative designs to customers, especially when it comes to products manufactured by SaniSure.
Assist engineering personnel with material sourcing for new parts in support of their designs.
Obtain and assemble data, including product data sheets and material quotes, to complete drawings and bills of materials (BOMs).
Ensure full technical documentation of designs including BOMs, drawings, schematics, engineering change control, and procedures adhere to customer requirements, industry regulations, and quality standards.
Assure efficient prioritization and task management. Directly engage in ongoing oversight of turn-around-times for drawings and BOMs. Drive the global team to meet or exceed their objectives for established metrics and Targets To Improve (TTIs), especially time commitments, while maintaining accuracy.
Work with R&D, New Product Introduction, and with Manufacturing to integrate a Design for Manufacture & Assembly (DFMA) and Design to Cost (DTC) perspective.
Maintain organized and controlled records of all drawings and BOMs. Drive and facilitate assigned portions of product change management and control.
Own data integrity and data services when it comes to item master creation and curating assigned product data within SaniSure databases. This includes Product Data Management (PDM) and ERP.
Support product configuration management.
Develop and maintain positive rapport and working relationships with other personnel across the organization in support of initiatives to execute product improvements and enhancements.
Provide technical direction and guidance to less experienced Engineers and Drafters.
Provide inputs for departmental budgeting, and track and manage to assure spending stays within set parameters.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering; Master's preferred.

Required Experience & Competencies

Minimum 10 years of overall Engineering experience.
Minimum 5 years in a former role managing a team of Engineers.
Experience with staffing, and with growing and developing strong teams. This includes active performance management.
Experience setting top-down department goals and objectives tied to business metrics and driving team performance in the context of business results.
Expert knowledge and demonstrated hands-on experience with Solidworks CAD software, both 3D and 2D.
Knowledge of plastic component and tool design, especially injection molding, and some blow molding.
Able to read and comprehend and interpret documents such as drawings, BOMs, blueprints, and operating procedures. Able to train and guide less experienced personnel on proper interpretation and best practices.
Advanced understanding of mathematical fundamentals of plane and solid geometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Design control, change control, risk management experience (FMEA).
In depth knowledge of creation of 2D and 3D drawings and related Bill of Materials (BoMs).
Able to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Strong MS Office skills, including Excel.
Strong ERP knowledge, SyteLine preferred.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Patient, tactful, diplomatic, and approachable.
Able to represent SaniSure from a position of design expertise when customer-facing.
Able to stay calm in challenging situations.
Keen sense of urgency and ability to deliver ahead of deadlines.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Able to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
Able to effectively work in a fast-paced environment and frequently manage multiple priorities.
Must be self-motivated, amendable to a variety of work projects and work efficiently independently and as part of a team.
Excellent follow-up skills.
Preferred experience: Single Use Consumable design and development experience, experience working with multiple bioprocessing equipment suppliers.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

CorpTech Platform is the internal engineering force multiplier behind Anduril's corporate systems.

It drives CorpTech engineering forward through strategic investment in data platforms, software platforms, QA and release excellence, ERP engineering, and AI infrastructure.

We build the foundations that power both CorpOS, enabling Finance and Growth to operate with speed and precision, and ArsenalOS, the digital backbone of Anduril's hardware enterprise. By unifying systems, accelerating development velocity, and embedding intelligence into every layer, CorpTech Platform transforms how the company operates end to end.

We are also driving Anduril toward becoming an autonomous enterprise. Through initiatives like the Autonomous Software Factory, we are rethinking how software is built, tested, deployed, and evolved by integrating AI directly into the engineering lifecycle. CorpTech Platform is how Anduril scales its business systems with the same rigor, speed, and adaptability as its mission critical products.

About The Job

The Director of Site Reliability Engineering owns the reliability system for the software that runs Anduril's business and manufacturing operations. This role leads the SRE organization and partners with software engineering leaders to make availability, resilience, performance, and production readiness shared engineering outcomes. The mandate extends beyond responding well when systems fail: it is to reduce the frequency and impact of failure through sound architecture, durable infrastructure, clear service ownership, and disciplined operating mechanisms.

You will set the portfolio-wide reliability strategy, build the team and leadership structure required to execute it, and give senior leaders a clear view of operational risk and investment choices. The strongest candidate will combine deep technical judgment with organizational leadership and will know when to establish a common standard, when to build a shared capability, and when to enable an engineering team to own the solution directly.

What You'll Do

Build and lead the Site Reliability Engineering organization, including hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and development of managers and senior technical leaders.
Own the reliability strategy for CorpTech Platform's production portfolio, translating operational risk and business criticality into a sequenced roadmap of engineering and infrastructure investments.
Establish shared accountability between SRE and software engineering through clear service ownership, SLOs, production-readiness standards, on-call expectations, and escalation mechanisms.
Set direction for observability, deployment safety, incident management, capacity planning, resilience, and disaster recovery across business-critical systems and shared infrastructure.
Partner with engineering, product, security, and business operations leaders to make informed trade-offs between delivery speed, reliability, cost, and long-term platform health.
Lead the organizational response to critical incidents, ensure communication and decision-making remain effective under pressure, and hold teams accountable for durable post-incident improvements.
Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil by turning cross-system failure patterns into platform capabilities, automation, architectural changes, and clearer ownership boundaries.
Define meaningful reliability measures and operating reviews that expose systemic risk, guide investment decisions, and demonstrate progress without incentivizing superficial compliance.
Create a healthy on-call system with the staffing, tooling, training, and management support required to sustain reliable services without normalizing burnout or heroics.
Establish reliability practices for AI-enabled systems, including appropriate observability, evaluation, degradation, and fallback mechanisms for non-deterministic production behavior.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, production engineering, infrastructure engineering, software engineering, or a closely related discipline, including significant experience leading engineering teams and managers.
Demonstrated success leading an SRE, infrastructure, or production engineering organization accountable for a diverse portfolio of business-critical systems at meaningful scale.
Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, performance management, organizational design, and development of managers and senior individual contributors.
Deep technical fluency across distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, networking, storage, observability, deployment systems, and the failure modes of each layer.
Experience establishing SLOs, production-readiness standards, incident management systems, on-call practices, and operational maturity mechanisms across multiple engineering teams.
Track record of improving reliability through systemic engineering investments and shared accountability with software engineering rather than relying on reactive support or manual controls.
Demonstrated ability to assess operational and business risk, prioritize investments across competing needs, and lead effectively through complex production incidents.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior engineers, executive leadership, and cross-functional partners.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading reliability for enterprise, manufacturing, or other operationally critical systems with complex dependencies and varied service maturity.
Experience building or scaling an SRE organization in a hyper growth environment while improving both service health and engineering velocity.
Experience operating in a federated engineering model in which reliability standards and shared capabilities must influence teams outside the direct reporting line.
Familiarity with AI-enabled production systems, including observability, evaluation, safeguards, and graceful degradation for non-deterministic behavior.
Experience with enterprise systems and business process domains such as ERP, MES, WMS, CRM, finance systems, or manufacturing systems.
Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
About The Role

In this role, the Director of Engineering Operations will provide technical guidance for a commercial, retail, and industrial portfolio in New York City and the suburban NYC metropolitan area.

The position will work closely with outsourced service providers and internal staff to ensure that each property meets or exceeds the Company's Global Standards for quality service, safety, and professional appearance.

Candidate will have an engineering background in commercial real estate operations or facilities management with deep expertise in the operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire/life safety systems as well as building automation systems. Candidate will also have experience overseeing capital projects and large repairs and maintenance projects related to building infrastructure and site improvements. A proven track record leading on-site teams as well as remote team members is a must.

Candidate must have working knowledge of the NYC Climate Mobilization Act, and in particular Local Law 97 relating to the commitment to achieve certain reductions in greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Candidate will have direct engineering experience in developing plans and strategies for commercial buildings achieving long term compliance with the various local laws comprised under the Act.

The ideal candidate will have prior exposure to more than one asset type; at minimum, the candidate should have significant experience with commercial office buildings (both Class A high-rise and Class B suburban office) or asset types with similar breadth and complexity of engineered systems. Candidate must demonstrate success in a fast-paced and flexible environment and be able to work effectively across all levels of the organization from building maintenance technicians to senior executives. Strong verbal and written communication skills are critical, as is proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and computerized maintenance management systems (e.g., Angus, Building Engines, etc.) for preventive maintenance, scheduled repairs, and tenant requests.

What You'll Do

Provide support and be a resource for engineers and maintenance staff ranging from entry level to Supervising Chief Engineer.
Report directly to the Property Management Market Leader for New York and provide technical support and guidance to property management staff on complex engineering issues, preventive and predictive maintenance, safety training and standard processes for safety, emergency preparedness and response, and capital project planning and execution.
Work with enterprise colleagues to implement strategic and operational initiatives related to safety, technical consulting, preventive maintenance, engineering operational performance, capital project supervision and tracking, engineering technology, etc.
Participate with property management teams in the development of property budgets for capital expenditures, maintenance, and repairs.
Conduct Engineering Operations Reviews at selected properties on an annual basis to assess operational performance and ensure compliance with operational guidelines.
Perform property walkthroughs and detailed inspections of major building systems and infrastructure to support transaction due diligence on behalf of investor clients and CBRE brokers.
Create RFPs and manage the contractor prequalification, bidding, and selection process for capital projects and large repair and maintenance projects.
Find opportunities to supervise large or complex capital projects related to building infrastructure (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, vertical transportation, curtain wall, roof, etc.) or site improvements (site lighting, flat work, etc.) at CBRE managed properties and work with market leadership to secure construction management fees in accordance with applicable terms of the property management agreement.
Work with senior leadership and business unit leaders to make project recommendations with follow-through to completion.
Maintain strong relations with vendors, consulting engineers, manufacturer’s representatives, and other third-party service providers to ensure compliance with Company policies, applicable codes/laws/ordinances, quality standards, and schedule requirements.
Manage the planning, organization, and controls for a major functional area or department. May be responsible for a mix of direct and matrix reports. Approves subordinate's recommendations for staff recruitment, selection, promotion, advancement, corrective action and termination. Effectively recommend same for direct reports to next level management for review and approval. Monitor appropriate staffing levels and reports on utilization and deployment of human resources. Lead and support staff in areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising and rewarding performance and retention. Lead by example and demonstrates behaviors that are consistent with the company's values.

What You'll Need

To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) from four-year college or university and a minimum of 15 years of experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience. This position requires hands-on experience in engineering/facilities management of commercial and industrial buildings including at least five (5) years of project management experience supervising typical building infrastructure projects such as elevator modifications/upgrades, HVAC equipment replacements, lighting retrofits, curtain wall repairs, roof work, concrete flat work, etc.
One or more of the following preferred: Local Operating Engineer's License or Trade License, Systems Maintenance Administrator (SMA), and/or Real Property Administrator (RPA). LEED AP or Green Associate accreditation and/or Project Management Professional certification are also preferred.
Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret the most complex business documents. Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive issues. Ability to write reports, manuals, speeches and articles using distinctive style. Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations on complex topics to employees, clients, top management and/or public groups. Ability to motivate and negotiate effectively with key employees, top management, and client groups to take desired action.
Requires in-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles. Reviews complex financial/business analysis and reports prepared by subordinates. Ability to analyze complex business/financial data and develop innovative solutions. Adheres strictly to financial policies and procedures.
Ability to solve advanced problems and deal with a variety of options in complex situations. Requires expert level analytical and quantitative skills with proven experience in developing strategic solutions for a growing matrix-based multi-industry sales environment. Draws upon the analysis of others and makes recommendations that have a direct impact on the company.
Intermediate skills with Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, and intranet/internet. Advanced understanding of maintenance management work order systems (Angus, Building Engines, etc.). Working knowledge of asset management, property management, leasing, disposition, and development.
Decisions made with in-depth understanding and interpretation of procedures, company policies and business practices to achieve complex results. Responsible for setting project, department and/or division deadlines. Errors in judgment may cause long-term impact to line of business and/or overall company.

Why CBRE?

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.

Our Values in Hiring

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

About CBRE Group, Inc.

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). Overview:

The National Security Sciences Directorate (NSSD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) seeks applicants for the position of Division Director for the Safeguards and Security Technology Division (SSTD). SSTD is comprised of multidisciplinary scientists, engineers, and mission-focused professionals who advance the scientific and technical foundations of nuclear safeguards and security. The Division develops innovative technologies and operational solutions that enable U.S. government agencies to strengthen the security and safeguards of nuclear and radiological materials in the U.S. and around the world, ultimately enhancing U.S. national security.

The Division collaborates extensively across ORNL and the broader DOE complex to advance technologies and approaches supporting nuclear safeguards, security, treaty verification spanning the nuclear fuel cycle and radiological operations. We're not hiring a VP of Engineering to sit in meetings. We're hiring our mad scientist
— the person who prototypes the thing everyone said was a quarter away, ships it in a week, and then builds the systems that make it production-grade.

Build.
Stay hands-on in the codebase most of your week — from our consumer platform to our Partner API to our AI research and content pipelines.
Drive AI innovation.
Own the architecture behind our LLM-powered research engine: retrieval, evaluation, cost accounting, and caching. Push what's possible before competitors know it's possible.
Lead the team.
Manage and prioritize our offshore engineering team day to day, and design + recruit the in-house engineering team we build next.
Set the bar.
Establish engineering standards — code review, testing, CI/CD, release process, AI evals — that raise quality without killing velocity.
Shape the culture.
Make Moby engineering a place where great builders want to work: high autonomy, high trust, high output.
Partner with founders.
Work directly with the co-founders on product strategy, technical due diligence for partnerships, and build-vs-buy decisions.

A senior engineer/leader who has shipped at scale — ideally with time at a top-tier tech company (Apple, Meta, Google, Amazon) or a major fintech — and now wants ownership, speed, and impact over bureaucracy.
Deeply fluent in modern AI development: LLM applications, RAG, evals, and the economics of running AI in production.
A builder first. You'd rather prototype the answer than write a memo about it — but you know when a prototype needs to become a system.
An experienced people leader who can run distributed teams and knows how to hire exceptional engineers.
Comfortable across the stack (we work in Go, Node.js, NextJS, Flutter, GCP/Postgres — you don't need all of them, but you need range).
Excited by markets and investing. You don't need a finance background, but you should find the problem space fascinating.

Real ownership.
You'll be the most senior technical person at the company, reporting directly to a co-founder.
A playground, not a maintenance job.
New products get greenlit and shipped in weeks, not quarters — AI chat, partner APIs, research tooling, trading integrations.
Leverage.
A small team reaching tens of millions of people, with AI doing the heavy lifting.
Equity that matters.
Meaningful ownership in a fast-growing, revenue-generating company.

NYC metro strongly preferred (hybrid); open to full remote within US time zones for an exceptional candidate.
Compensation: $200,000 base salary + equity.

ABOUT BEST BRANDS

Best Brands is a consumer goods importer and wholesaler supplying major U.S. retail accounts including Dollar Tree, Walmart, Amazon, Publix, and TJX. We operate a fast-moving supply chain with a lean, high-ownership team — the people who join us run their domains, not just their tasks.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Best Brands is seeking a Director of IT who operates at the intersection of systems and operations. You’ll directly oversee a growing IT department with ability to develop a functional team.
This role is a Sr. Doer role that will own the full technology stack powering our import supply chain — from hardware and network infrastructure to ERP configuration and EDI connectivity, as well as 3PL integrations, BI reporting, and workflow automation.
You don't wait to be told – you identify the gap, build the fix, and document it. You can hold a technical conversation with a developer and a business conversation with a VP in the same afternoon, and you treat EDI rejections and data anomalies like puzzles rather than problems. You've lived the importer calendar — CRDs, ship windows, DC compliance, and the cost of a missed ASN — and you build systems that outlast your involvement.
You will also be the internal authority on ERP owning data integrity, process flags, user configuration, and diagnostic troubleshooting — while also leading the build-out of our BI and forecasting infrastructure. The right candidate is self-directed, thrives in a fast-moving importer environment, and can translate technical complexity into operational clarity for cross-functional stakeholders.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

IT Infrastructure

·      Own and maintain company-wide IT infrastructure — servers, networks, endpoints, and cloud environments — ensuring uptime, scalability, and security across all sites and the 3PL/warehouse footprint.
·      Manage LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity to support ERP, EDI, and warehouse operations, including reliable links to 3PL partners.
·      Establish and enforce network security, access controls, backup/disaster recovery, and business continuity policies to protect data and minimize downtime.
·      Oversee vendor and ISP relationships, hardware/software procurement, and infrastructure budgeting, while planning capacity for growth across retail accounts.

ERP Management (Cold Lion)

·      Serve as the internal subject matter expert and system owner for ERP.
·      Manage system configuration, workflow controls, and automation triggers, user permissions, and system settings.
·      Lead diagnostics and root-cause analysis on data issues, workflow failures, and integration errors.
·      Partner with IT to scope and execute system upgrades, patches, and new module rollouts.
·      Build and maintain documentation for all ERP processes and configurations.
EDI & Integrations

·      Own end-to-end EDI operations — including 850, 856 ASN, 810, and 940/945 transaction sets.
·      Troubleshoot and resolve EDI rejections, mapping errors, and trading partner compliance issues.
·      Manage API integrations between Cold Lion, 3PLs, retail portals, and BI tools.
·      Drive automation initiatives that eliminate manual touchpoints in daily workflows.

3PL Partner Management

·      Serve as the primary systems liaison to multi-site 3PLs.
·      Own WMS connectivity, inbound/outbound data flows, and inventory reconciliation between ERP and 3PL.
·      Support onboarding and migration activities — including current Geodis-to-Westmark transition.
·      Drive escalations and system-level issue resolution directly with 3PL IT and operations teams.
Reporting, BI & Forecasting

·      Lead the design and build of BI infrastructure using ERP as the primary data source and steering development partners.
·      Own rolling operating forecast (ROF) tooling and data pipelines from ERP to reporting layer.
·      Build and maintain dashboards and reports for supply chain KPIs, inventory, fulfillment, and vendor performance.
·      Evaluate and implement AI-assisted tools to improve forecast accuracy and operational decision-making.
Daily Operations & Workflow

·      Support daily importer workflows: PO management, ASN generation, inbound tracking, and inventory receipts.
·      Act as a cross-functional resource for operations, procurement, and logistics teams on system-related issues.
·      Build and enforce SOPs for ERP data entry, EDI submission, and 3PL communication protocols.

WHAT TO BRING

Required

·      8-12 years of experience in IT infrastructure, ERP administration, supply chain systems, EDI, and IT operations in an import/wholesale environment.
·      IT systems and infrastructure experts with ability to maintain on-premises and cloud-based environments.

·      Direct experience working with 3PL partners on WMS integration, inventory sync, and data reconciliation.

·      Exposure to AI/ML/LLM tooling applied to forecasting, demand planning, or workflow automation.
·      Key retail account experience — Dollar Tree, Walmart, Amazon, Publix, TJX, etc. a plus.

About Lindy
Our mission is to free humanity from work. We're starting by building an AI employee, not another tool people have to operate.
Lindy is like any other teammate: it joins your Slack, can be @-mentioned for help about anything, uses all your tools, and even builds its own if needed. It already saves countless hours to grateful teams who could no longer imagine working without it.

Our Culture
Lindy's Culture: https://app.notion.com/p/lindyai/Lindy-s-Culture-8f24be7f619a4e4aa7e93ba02d58cf4c

You can expect an environment with little process and high empowerment, paired with high expectations and a strong sense of urgency. We're a small team of smart, intense people dedicated to doing the best work of our lives.

We are an in-office company, working from our downtown San Francisco office 4+ days a week. We sponsor visas and cover relocation costs up to $20,000.

The Role
We're looking for someone to own engineering at Lindy.
We build a genuinely complex product: an agent that acts on real people's email, calendars, meetings, and company data, where being wrong has consequences.
You'll own the operating system and delivery: how work gets planned, reviewed, shipped, and kept running, plus the reliability bar, hiring, and standards. You'll report to the CEO and partner closely with our Senior Engineering Manager, our engineers, and product.
This is a builder's job. You'll still read code, review PRs, occasionally write them, and make architecture calls.

Key Responsibilities
Own engineering execution. Planning cadence, prioritization, and delivery. We must ship!
Build the operating system. On-call that works, CI that's fast, fast code reviews, clean project handoffs, incident response, and a standup and review cadence people actually get value from.
Own reliability. Our agent's reliability is the company's top priority. You own driving it up, and the eval infrastructure and self-improvement loops that get it there.
Build an AI-native engineering organization. Engineering itself is being rewritten. You'll push agentic development, AI code review, and the internal tooling that lets a small team out-ship a large one, and you'll measure whether it's actually working.
Own hiring and onboarding. Raise the bar, run a tight process, and get new engineers productive and clear about their responsibilities.
Dive deep. Review code, weigh in on architecture, and keep enough context to have real opinions.

Who You Are
You've built the machine before. You've led a 10-30 person engineering organization at a startup and personally installed the processes that made it work. You can walk us through what was broken, what you changed, and what happened to cycle time and quality.
Player-coach. You're a strong engineer who chose to lead, and you haven't stopped being an engineer. You don't lead from a distance.
AI-pilled. You're not just excited about AI. You have rebuilt your own and your team's workflow around agents, and you have real opinions about what works and what is theater.
You hold a high bar. You create an intense environment to do great work. You give feedback frequently, quickly, kindly, and specifically.
You have backbone. The team is direct and will tell you when it disagrees. We want someone who brings data and holds the line when they think they're right.
You have taste for reliability. You've owned a production system where failures were visible to customers, and you know the difference between a system that mostly works and one that's rock solid.

Bonus Qualifications
Experience with LLM applications, agent infrastructure, or eval systems.
Background in SRE, production engineering, or developer experience.
Experience with products that are simultaneously consumer-grade in polish and B2B in requirements.
You've hired and grown engineers who went on to do great things.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range $260–$330k + significant equity.
Excellent health coverage.
$20K relocation assistance if currently outside of the Bay Area, and visa sponsorship.
High autonomy and direct collaboration with the founder.
